core_principles: No duplicate modules or parallel accounting tables
Single core accounting entry for contributions, count sessions, deposits, and accounts payable
Strict RBAC & Confidentiality: restricted backend access for financial records (Finance team & Senior Pastors only)
Audit trail & non-destructive history for all transactions, edits, and adjustments
High density, scan-optimized fast batch entry interface for envelope count sessions (mobile and desktop/tablet support)
Strict approval workflow: AP status transitions (Pendiente -> Aprobada -> Programada -> Pagada)
financial_module_guidelines.pushpay_integration_status: MOCKED / BLOCKED until live API credentials are provided

general_ui_ux_guidelines.testing_attribute: Every interactive and key informational element MUST include data-testid with kebab-case identifiers (e.g. data-testid="finance-contribution-submit-button").
general_ui_ux_guidelines.responsive_breakpoints: Full compatibility required across desktop (1920x800), tablet (768px-1024px), and mobile (390x844).
general_ui_ux_guidelines.contrast_and_accessibility: Ensure 4.5:1 minimum contrast ratio for normal text on dark backgrounds with gold accents.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.component_files: This project uses JS/JSX component files (.js). Ensure guidelines target standard React Javascript structures.
general_ui_ux_guidelines.no_transparent_overlays: Never use fully transparent header backgrounds; use backdrop-blur-md with dark translucent fills to maintain legibility.

instructions_to_main_agent: Verify existing endpoints and database schemas before extending components.
Maintain institutional navy and gold visual styling consistently.
Ensure all forms have proper validation, state persistence, and toast feedback via Sonner.
Support RBAC checks on both API endpoints and frontend rendering for financial confidentiality.
